source_method: OpenAI built-in image_gen created the complete topic-specific residential scene. No existing site image or product image was reused.

visual_review.notes: The full-size image and both centered crops clearly show a main residence and a separate cottage or workshop, with one understated local controller visible naturally inside each building. The warm evening light, natural wood and stone, garden, and restrained dark-green tones match Tara's residential direction. There is no headline, logo, poster text, screen, chart, diagram, route line, translucent panel, inset frame, floating UI card, progress bar, or repeated generic asset.
